title: Paid Leave: Estimate Your Paid Leave Payments
issuer: Washington Employment Security Department, Paid Family and Medical Leave

passages.question: How much Paid Leave premium did payroll take from employees, and what does HANGS pay?
passages.excerpt: As of Jan. 1, 2026, the premium rate is 1.13% of each employee’s gross wages, not including tips, up to the 2026 Social Security cap ($184,500). Of this, employers with 50+ employees will pay up to 28.57% and employees will pay 71.43%. Employers cannot collect missed premiums in later pay periods
